brief.headline: Northwind Group Closes $1B Debt Fund
bullets: Fundraising: The private lender’s Northwind Debt Fund III (NDF III) closed with $1 billion in committed capital after setting a $500 million goal for the credit vehicle in January 2025.
Fundraising: Blackstone has held the final close of Blackstone Energy Transition Partners V at $8.7 billion.

M&A & Buyouts: EQT is in advanced negotiations to acquire European molecular testing company Qiagen in a potential buyout valued at more than $10bn, with rival private equity firm KKR also submitting a bid, according to a report by Bloomberg.
M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone and Warburg Pincus are exploring a sale of US financial technology company IntraFi that could value the business at more than $10bn, according to a report by Reuters.
Hotels & Hospitality: Service Properties Trust hired Sonesta to operate 68 of the hotels it owns.

items.takeaway: Macquarie Asset Management has hired Linso Pals from Blackstone to head up credit within its client solutions group.

items.title: Amundi raises €200m in first close of fifth-generation private debt fund
items.takeaway: Amundi has raised nearly €200m (£167.7m) in its initial closing of Amundi Senior Private Debt V. The debt fund targets institutional investors in France seeking exposure to mid-sized companies operating in sectors such as healthcare, technology and B2B services.
items.whyItMatters: Amundi's €200m raise shows investors are still committing money to private credit, and a strong raise makes it easier for other managers in the strategy to raise too.

items.title: Mansion House Accord fuels over £11bn in UK private markets
items.takeaway: Mansion House Accord signatories held £11.1bn in UK private markets at the end of last year, according to joint tracking by the Association of British Insurers (ABI) and Pensions UK.
items.whyItMatters: Alternative managers increasingly own or partner with insurers, using long-term policyholder capital to fund private credit.

items.title: Centerbridge and Mubadala near £1bn Canaccord Wealth deal
items.takeaway: Centerbridge Partners and Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala Investment Company are in talks to acquire Canaccord Genuity's UK wealth management business in a transaction valued at approximately £1bn, according to a report by Bloomberg.
items.whyItMatters: Large transactions reset valuation benchmarks for comparable companies, public and private.

items.title: Partners Group cuts fees on €6.6bn evergreen fund amid redemption pressure
items.takeaway: Partners Group is reducing management fees on its €6.6bn Global Value SICAV evergreen private equity fund as it seeks investor approval for a restructuring following elevated redemption requests, according to a report by Bloomberg.
items.whyItMatters: Partners Group's fee cut shows the pressure on what private-markets managers can charge, which over time leaves more of the return with investors.

items.title: Elevation Point Stakes $750M Ex-UBS Team in Las Vegas
items.takeaway: Jim Dickson's firm backs the Las Vegas-based Truing Capital, formerly affiliated with UBS, as it pursues an ambitious $50 billion growth target over the next two years.
items.whyItMatters: Advisors who move usually take most of their clients' assets with them, so moves like this show which firms are winning the competition for advisors and client money.

items.title: Wealthspire Division Acquires $1B Wealth Manager in London
items.takeaway: Wealthspire's entertainment and sports unit expands its U.K. footprint, picking up London-based Atlantic Swiss that oversees more than $1 billion for clients in media and sports.
items.whyItMatters: Wealthspire Division's deal adds to the consolidation of advisory firms, which gives clients bigger platforms but can change their advisor's fees, products and independence.

items.title: Northwind Group Closes $1B Debt Fund
items.takeaway: The private lender’s Northwind Debt Fund III (NDF III) closed with $1 billion in committed capital after setting a $500 million goal for the credit vehicle in January 2025.
items.whyItMatters: Northwind Group's new fund shows where investors are putting money in property, and fresh capital tends to support prices for the kind of property it targets.

items.title: Sonesta Cuts Jobs as a $2 Billion Bid Puts Many of Its Best Hotels in Play
items.takeaway: Service Properties Trust hired Sonesta to operate 68 of the hotels it owns.
items.whyItMatters: A $2 billion bid for these hotels shows what buyers will pay for hotels today, a price benchmark for hotel owners, lenders and the REITs that own them.

items.title: Hilton Launches Pay With Points
items.takeaway: The new Hilton Honors benefit enables members with Silver, Gold, Diamond, or Diamond Reserve status to apply Points toward eligible hotel charges during Digital Check Out in the Hilton Honors App.
items.whyItMatters: Hotel values move with travel demand and room rates, so hotel news is an early read on consumer and business spending.

items.title: Morehouse, Spelman Debut $147M Student Housing Project
items.takeaway: Radnor Property Group, in partnership with Madrone Community Development Foundation, joined Morehouse College and Spelman College in breaking ground on The Den at Eight50 West: a $147 million student housing development in the West End neighborhood of Atlanta.
items.whyItMatters: New student housing supply like this can hold down rents nearby once it opens, so it matters to owners and lenders of competing student housing.

beginnerNote.explanation: A property's yearly net operating income divided by its price. A building earning $5 million a year that sells for $100 million has a 5% cap rate. A lower cap rate means a higher price, and cap rates tend to rise when interest rates rise.

items.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management Raised Its Long-Term Hedge Fund Return Forecast to 6.7%
items.takeaway: J.P. Morgan Asset Management has raised its 10-to-15-year return forecast for diversified hedge funds to 6.7% from 5.3%, a 140-basis-point increase.
items.whyItMatters: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's raise shows investors are still committing money to hedge funds, and a strong raise makes it easier for other managers in the strategy to raise too.

items.title: U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETFs Took In $23.2 Million on October 20 as Inflows Slowed After Monday’s Surge
items.takeaway: U.S. spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds drew a net $23.2 million on Tuesday, October 20, according to Farside Investors data.
items.whyItMatters: $23.2 million of new money shows demand for crypto is still growing, and money keeps flowing to the biggest managers, which gives them more say over fees and terms.
